findings.title: pauseWithdraw leaves phUSD emission rate anchored to pre-exit totalStaked, minting unbacked phUSD to survivors
findings.status: CORROBORATION — collapses into ECON-09-001, not an independent finding
findings.rootCause: pauseWithdraw (src/PhlimboV3.sol:596-611) mutates totalStaked at :601-602 but never calls _updatePhUSDEmissionRate() (:893-901). It is the ONLY totalStaked mutation site that omits the re-derivation — stake calls it at :674, withdraw at :725, setDesiredAPY at :245. phUSDPerSecond therefore stays anchored to the pre-exit totalStaked while _updatePool (:805-808) divides that stale, too-large numerator by the new, SMALLER totalStaked, so surviving stakers realize the departed cohort's entire emission. The phUSD leg is MINTED and uncapped (:853) — unlike the stable leg, which _updatePool bounds by rewardBalance (:789) — so the excess is unbacked supply rather than a redistribution of a funded pool.

evidence.fuzz: invariant_phUSDRate_tracks_totalStaked BROKE on the first run with a 3-call shrunk sequence: stake -> pauseContract -> pauseWithdraw. Observed phUSDPerSecond = 177751057212395 vs expected 36818786564632 (4.83x stale).
evidence.directedMeasurement: test_ECON_09_001_pauseWithdraw_uncapped_overmint reproduces the econ-scanner's exact operating point (68,000 phUSD staked, 5% APY, 8.5x collapse to 8,000 via pauseWithdraw, 1-day window): phUSD minted to survivor = 9.315068493150632, fair entitlement = 1.095890410958832, UNBACKED = 8.219178082191800 phUSD/day. This matches the econ-scanner's independently derived 8.219 phUSD/day figure to the wei.
evidence.persistence: test_ECON_09_001_stale_rate_persists_until_unrelated_stake shows the stale rate survives 30 days and a claim() — the leak is not self-correcting. Only an unrelated stake/withdraw (:674/:725) re-derives it.

findings.suggestedFix: Call _updatePhUSDEmissionRate() in pauseWithdraw after the totalStaked mutation at :602, matching stake (:674) and withdraw (:725). Note pauseWithdraw also skips _updatePool, so the rate should be re-derived after any accrual settlement to avoid retroactively repricing the elapsed window.
findings.notes: Filed under the invariant- prefix for traceability of the independent Tier-3 confirmation. It is NOT a second finding: dedup should collapse INVARIANT-09-001 into ECON-09-001. Reported here because an analytic derivation and an empirical measurement agreeing on 8.219 phUSD/day is materially stronger evidence than either alone.
